name: Naktamun
description: Naktamun is the great city of Amonkhet, protected by the Hekma, where initiates train for the trials and the gods walk.

description_citations.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

summary.text: Naktamun is the great city of Amonkhet, protected by the Hekma, where initiates train for the trials and the gods walk.

citations.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

bio.text: Rhonas's monument stands in the city by the river, and the Hekma protects it from the desert wastes.

citations.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.
"Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

bio.text: Years afterward, Ketramose marches toward Naktamun with Temmet.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

status.text: The latest page describes Naktamun as a healing city on Amonkhet, from which Mahitab and her party set out, with Ketramose marching toward it.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Gideon decides they should keep their other-planar origin hidden despite Chandra's wish to open the people's eyes.
timeline.quote: We shouldn't draw attention to ourselves any more than we need to

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana charms Temmet by claiming they were on a mission for the Horned One, and the group learns the standard greeting.
timeline.quote: "We have been out in the desert for some time," she said, "on a special mission for the Horned One."

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Temmet leads them through the city, where they see people training and the Anointed doing all labor.
timeline.quote: "The Anointed perform all the work here, so the living need do nothing but train.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon meets the god Oketra, who names him Kytheon Iora and says the others' fates are undecided.
timeline.quote: "You're one of mine, Kytheon Iora," she said.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon recalls Heliod and the death of his Irregulars, doubting he can trust a god again.
timeline.quote: The mission Heliod had set before him had led to the death of Gideon's closest friends, his Irregulars.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Temmet lodges them in two rooms; Gideon watches Oketra walk to her temple.
timeline.quote: Liliana swept into one of the rooms and closed the door without a word.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: On the balcony Gideon tells Chandra his birth name was Kytheon Iora and explains what gods are and how Oketra differs.
timeline.quote: "Kytheon," he said. "Kytheon Iora."

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: A woman runs through the street shouting that the trials, gods and hours are lies; soldiers including a minotaur capture her while Gideon restrains Chandra.
timeline.quote: "The return will bring only devastation and ruin!"

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon promises to quietly investigate and says there is no deception in Oketra, while Jace and Liliana doubt gods.
timeline.quote: But there is no deception in Oketra.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Temmet explains the woman was pursued by viziers of Bontu and her crop was due for a trial; the group wonders if the people are being harvested.
timeline.quote: "She proved herself unworthy of life among us."

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Unable to sleep, Gideon seeks out Oketra at dawn, telling her he seeks her.
timeline.quote: "You," he said.

citation.text: "Trust" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes, finds the plane's soul painful to touch, and asks Chandra to search for the shouting woman.
timeline.quote: "I'm going to go on a walk to find the woman from yesterday.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: A mummy bursts in with breakfast, startling the group.
timeline.quote: a white-bandaged mummy burst through the door carrying a tray of bread and a carafe of what smelled like ale.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra walk through Naktamun, noting that everyone is a trainee under twenty and mummies do all the labor.
timeline.quote: The enchanted dead were the ones who did all the work.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa, feeling ill, confesses to Chandra that she is learning what friendship means; Chandra says she wants to be a good friend.
timeline.quote: "I am thankful for your companionship.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: In an old alley, Nissa sees carved glyphs showing eight gods and a recently added horns sigil, concluding Bolas corrupted rather than created Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas didn't create this world , she realized, he corrupted it.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra appears, forbids approaching the sarcophagi, and Nissa tells her telepathically that her world is dying; Oketra shows fear and has no memory of before.
timeline.quote: " These sarcophagi are forbidden to approach ," Oketra said out loud.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon reveals he is competing in the Trials as Oketra's Champion despite Chandra's objections.
timeline.quote: "These gods are good at their core. I want to prove myself to them."

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Chandra that Bolas corrupted Amonkhet only decades ago, and they resolve to learn what he changed and to speak with Kefnet.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas must have come and gone only a few decades ago.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon follows Oketra through Naktamun and watches her warm, kind interactions with the people.
timeline.quote: There was no groveling, no fear from the masses before an almighty presence.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, wearing a cartouche Oketra gave him, comes to a celebration square where initiates feast before the Trial of Ambition.
timeline.quote: I noticed all these initiates had cartouches with three segments.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra tells Gideon this is where the Trials begin, then leaves him with the initiate Djeru, who greets him as a friend.
timeline.quote: I am Djeru of the Tah crop.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru spars with Gideon and wins, then introduces him to the crop.
timeline.quote: You're good. You could be better. Come.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon learns that crops lose members through the Trials, and Djeru's crop is replacing one lost the day before.
timeline.quote: Many other crops are culled significantly from Trial to Trial, and reformed with others.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Meris names the lost dissenter Samut, angering Djeru, who explains she chose heresy and was removed; Gideon recalls seeing a woman shouting that the gods lie.
timeline.quote: She is a dissenter ,

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu stalks into the square and asks who deserves to compete in her Trial; Gideon boldly asks whether even the gods are born strong.
timeline.quote: Not even the gods?

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu laughs at Gideon's brazenness and names him and the twenty members of the Tah crop as the next to face her Trial.
timeline.quote: You shall be next to face my Trial

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon tears the cartouche from his neck, resolving to strike down Bolas.
timeline.quote: I tore the cartouche from my neck, dropping it on the ground before me.

citation.text: "Brazen" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut leads her friends to an old mural of Hazoret and strange fighting forms, which she performs.
timeline.quote: Samut assumed the first stance on the mural

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Nakht wonders aloud whether there was a time before the gods, unsettling his friends.
timeline.quote: if there ever was a time before the gods.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Years later, the loss hardens Djeru's faith while Samut takes up doubt and searches the ancient parts of Naktamun.
timeline.quote: took up the mantle of doubt and questions

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut hides in an old embalming chamber after fleeing viziers and the anointed, and meets Djeru, who came disguised as a mummy.
timeline.quote: The wholesome face of her friend Djeru emerged

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut begs Djeru not to enter the final Trial, claiming the God-Pharaoh is a lie, but he refuses and walks out.
timeline.quote: Don't go to the final Trial.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut mentions Nakht, and Djeru angrily says Nakht died unworthy because of their foolish trespass.
timeline.quote: Nakht died unworthy , out there in the dunes, because of our stupidity.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru leaves, saying he will plead to Hazoret for her, which gives Samut an idea.
timeline.quote: I'll plead to Hazoret for you.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut is imprisoned in a sarcophagus among other dissenters, who tell her dissenters are the monsters of the Trial of Zeal.
timeline.quote: The monsters initiates face in the final Trial are the dissenters themselves.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut explains that she needs to save Djeru, believing he could convince a god they were lied to.
timeline.quote: If anyone could convince a god they'd been lied to, it's him.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Chandra free Samut from the sarcophagus, telling her they came to rescue her.
timeline.quote: He explained that they saw her days ago evading capture and came to rescue her.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch share information with Samut, learning that Bolas is a dragon from another world and has tampered with the gods.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh is a dragon from another world, Samut.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana reveals her third demon is on Amonkhet, and the Gatewatch quarrel angrily.
timeline.quote: My third demon is here.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut forces the group to focus on rescuing Djeru, and Gideon swears to help.
timeline.quote: I swear to help you save the life of your friend.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: All the gods approach and Hazoret takes Samut and the Gatewatch to face the last initiates, knocking them out.
timeline.quote: Your time has come

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The gods of Amonkhet fight the dragon outside the Hekma, and Oketra's arrows fail to harm him.
timeline.quote: The arrow hit the dragon's side, and he laughed.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon fractures Kefnet's mind in two, and Kefnet falls.
timeline.quote: The dragon tipped his chin and fractured Kefnet's mind in two.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: With Kefnet down, the Hekma wavers and the dragon bursts through it.
timeline.quote: the hole widened enough for the dragon to burst through.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon, protected by shifting half a step from reality, lands on the tallest tower and channels a spell.
timeline.quote: The dragon landed atop the tallest tower, closed his eyes, and began to channel a spell.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon dissipates every mortal old enough to walk, leaving only infants and the gods in shock.
timeline.quote: every mortal old enough to walk dissipated into the sky.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret and Oketra flee to a mausoleum and gather the orphaned children as the dragon follows.
timeline.quote: Hazoret began gently picking up as many children as she could.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon breaks the seal and blanks the minds of Hazoret and Oketra, who fall defeated.
timeline.quote: the minds of the two gods went utterly blank.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon takes three gods for himself and corrupts the leylines of the remaining gods to bind them to him and to forget their origins.
timeline.quote: he returned to the surface and took three of the gods for his own.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon raises the enchanted dead as caretakers and repurposes an elite sacrificial ceremony into the endless Trials, setting the second sun to move on his schedule.
timeline.quote: He spelled the second sun to move as he was ready

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru and Samut run to the Luxa as the Hours begin amid a stampede of citizens, and Hazoret strides to the river.
timeline.quote: all racing toward the banks of the Luxa River.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch resolves to find a vantage to ambush Bolas, and the others return to Naktamun, regarding Liliana coldly.
timeline.quote: Let us seek a better vantage to prepare for Nicol Bolas's arrival,

citation.text: "Feast" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The scorpion god tears the serpent in two and advances while the other two gods enter Naktamun.
timeline.quote: the other two gods crossed the threshold of the gate into the city of Naktamun.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: A quarter of the Hekma vanishes and marauding mummies pour into Naktamun while Kefnet tries in vain to repair the barrier.
timeline.quote: a wave of marauding mummies poured into the city from the wastes beyond.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra leads the beasts of the Holding out against the mummies and locusts, cutting down the dead with her poisoned scimitar.
timeline.quote: With every swipe of her blade, another mummy halted, hunched over, and fell to the earth

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra concludes it is the absent God-Pharaoh's fault and saves two children from mummies.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh who was not here.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra takes Samut and Djeru onto Tuya as they seek to protect Oketra.
timeline.quote: The two former initiates gracefully climbed atop Tuya

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra glimpses Gideon and Liliana running past, and Djeru tells her not to stop.
timeline.quote: One was Gideon, the broad-shouldered warrior Oketra had claimed as one of her own.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra finds Kefnet and Oketra confronting the scorpion god, and Oketra tells her the gods are there to protect the mortals.
timeline.quote: We are here to protect you

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Kefnet and Oketra fight the scorpion god in tandem, and it grazes Kefnet's wing.
timeline.quote: They moved in tandem with one another

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra's arrow of white light blasts through the scorpion god's head and it crumbles to dust.
timeline.quote: The scorpion god's pursuit was halted by Oketra's arrow of white light exploding through his head.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The scorpion god reconstitutes itself from dust and stabs Kefnet through the forehead, killing him.
timeline.quote: the beautiful and brilliant Kefnet, God of Knowledge, was dead before he hit the ground.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra leaps between Tuya and the scorpion god and is impaled by its stinger while Gideon cries out.
timeline.quote: the scorpion god's stinger was lodged in Oketra's gut.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra weeps for her gods, then tells Gideon the source of the hell is his responsibility to kill.
timeline.quote: Then he is your responsibility to kill.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra resolves to find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.
timeline.quote: We must find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret feels a third god die and kneels in despair, knowing only she and Bontu remain.
timeline.quote: Bontu and I are all that remain.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret lets go into her battle frenzy, cutting through mummies, saving a child and burning a hellion.
timeline.quote: Hazoret let go of any shreds of doubt and uncertainty

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret meets Samut and Djeru and orders them to protect others and hide until the God-Pharaoh comes, calling Djeru her final champion.
timeline.quote: And you, Djeru, my final champion.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks who will protect Hazoret, who tells her to fight and says she will endure.
timeline.quote: Who will protect you , Hazoret?

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The God-Pharaoh smiles at the destruction and unleashes black flames that consume the cheering mortals.
timeline.quote: a deluge of black flames streaked down, consuming everything it touched.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret shields the mortals with sand and flame and realizes the God-Pharaoh brings only destruction.
timeline.quote: He rains destruction upon his people, his children.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu kneels, hails Nicol Bolas by name and declares her servitude, revealing she has served him and culled dissenters.
timeline.quote: I have culled dissenters from all the crops

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas commands Bontu to kill her sister, and Bontu blasts Hazoret with dark energy.
timeline.quote: Kill your sister.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu's spell unlocks Hazoret's suppressed memories, and she remembers Bolas's deception.
timeline.quote: And suddenly, Hazoret remembered everything.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu explains she chose survival by joining Bolas, and the sisters duel.
timeline.quote: I chose to join with his power instead. I chose survival.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu bites Hazoret's arm, Hazoret burns her way free, and Bontu summons horrors that bind Hazoret in tar.
timeline.quote: their shadowy forms coalescing into a binding morass, restraining her.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu drains Hazoret and drops her at Bolas's feet, then Bolas blasts Bontu, calling her usefulness ended.
timeline.quote: Slowly, he raised one claw—and blasted Bontu with a bolt of dark energy.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas leaves to find the scarab god as undead swarm and drag down Bontu.
timeline.quote: flying toward the gate and the waiting scarab god.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu bursts free, slays the undead, frees Hazoret, and dies, severing her ties to the world.
timeline.quote: Bontu fell, the dragon's necrotic spell severing the final leylines that tied the god to this world.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret alone remains as the last pillar of Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: And Hazoret alone remained, the last pillar of Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Nylah, once indifferent to faith, finally believes as the city is destroyed and the gods die, and welcomes the horror as her Trial.
timeline.quote: This was her Trial.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Asenue holds off two Eternals to give others time to escape, though she knows she will lose.
timeline.quote: Every moment she stayed alive, that was another person not dying

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Asenue falters in mid-breath, implying her death.
timeline.quote: One more breath. One more breath. One. More. Brea —

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Genub and Makare flee together from the Eternals, but Genub loses her in the chaos.
timeline.quote: When next he stopped to breathe, Makare was not there.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Genub finds Makare, now an Eternal with glowing blue eyes, who cuts him down as he reaches for her.
timeline.quote: Hers was not the only blade that punctured his flesh, but it was the first.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Kawit, enraged at Oketra's death, takes one of her arrows as a spear and destroys a minotaur Eternal.
timeline.quote: There was a flash of white light as the minotaur disintegrated

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Kawit sees the dragon God-Pharaoh and realizes he is no impostor but the being they served.
timeline.quote: This dragon is not an impostor. This dragon is our God-Pharaoh.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Kawit hurls Oketra's spear at the dragon, but he freezes it and it snaps; he calls her useful only in a different world and walks away.
timeline.quote: you might have been useful.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Kawit's shield fails and the Eternals close in on her.
timeline.quote: The Eternals closed in, and Kawit did not have strength enough left to scream.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Amenakhte, mortally wounded after shielding a child with his body, begs a human woman to save the child and dies.
timeline.quote: all that Amenakhte had time to do was put himself between the falling blades and the child

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The woman promises Amenakhte that she will save the child as he dies.
timeline.quote: I will . . . save the child.

citation.text: "Hour of Eternity" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut leads a band of survivors toward the desert at Hazoret's command, guarded by Djeru.
timeline.quote: Hazoret's command burned at the back of Samut's thoughts as they moved.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas emerges from a void in the sky and rains black fire on the city and its cheering mortals.
timeline.quote: That was when the dragon raised his hands, and black fire fell from the skies.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut tells the survivors that the God-Pharaoh is a lie and a trespasser, and Masikah doubts her.
timeline.quote: He is a trespasser, an interloper from another world.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The survivors all feel the pain of a fourth god dying, and Samut tells them four gods are now dead.
timeline.quote: Four of our gods are now dead.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru publicly declares he stands with Samut against the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: I have seen more than I needed to realize she speaks truth.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut resolves to go back into the city to protect Hazoret, and Djeru and other warriors join her while Hapatra stays to guide the survivors into the sands.
timeline.quote: I am Rhonas's broken fang, and I know where to strike to stop the undead and the monstrosities in their tracks.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut and Djeru fight the Eternal Neheb the Worthy and are beaten back.
timeline.quote: Neheb swung his spear forward, sending a wave of flame at Samut.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon blocks Neheb's spear and the Gatewatch destroy the Eternals; Samut stabs Neheb and kills him.
timeline.quote: She sprinted toward the Eternal minotaur and stabbed him in the back with both khopeshes

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decide to bring the fight to Bolas, and Samut charges them to slay Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Slay the dragon trespasser. Slay Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru persuades Samut to stand down and find the last god while the Gatewatch fight Bolas.
timeline.quote: Find the last god of Amonkhet, protect her, and protect the people of our city.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut and Djeru, guided by the young vizier Haq, find Rhonas's body and Samut rallies the survivors.
timeline.quote: We will embody the strength Rhonas taught us

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: A sandstorm sweeps in as an injured Hazoret emerges pursued by the scorpion god.
timeline.quote: A scorpion's tail pierced through the haze

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret traps the scorpion god in a pillar of flame, but it keeps coming and poisons her arm, which she cauterizes and severs.
timeline.quote: Hazoret crouched, panting hard, blood seeping from the wound that had saved her life.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut leaps onto the scorpion god and cuts through its softened carapace while the survivors fight it.
timeline.quote: She smashed into the scorpion god's side, and her blades pierced its carapace

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: A khenra warrior wields Rhonas's reforged staff to knock the scorpion god back toward Djeru's trap.
timeline.quote: A lone khenra stood, hoisting Rhonas's staff into the air

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru trips the scorpion god and Samut redirects its fall so an obelisk pierces its chest.
timeline.quote: an earth-shattering crunch echoed across the battlefield as the obelisk pierced the scorpion god's chest.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret finishes the scorpion god with her spear, freeing him as her brother from his dark form.
timeline.quote: the god reduced to cinders and ash.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret thanks Samut, and Samut's planeswalker spark ignites; she is carried to another plane and returns to Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: she was falling, falling through space, through flashing waves of aether

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut realizes she is a walker between worlds and returns to Amonkhet, then collapses and is caught by Hazoret.
timeline.quote: I am a walker between worlds.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret tells the survivors to endure and leads them into the desert as Bolas flies above, and Djeru and the survivors kneel to her.
timeline.quote: we must simply endure, persist, survive

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Basri brings two teenage twin embalmers to Mahitab for a trek to find Temmet, and she objects.
timeline.quote: You've brought me children.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri tells Mahitab and Niharet he will pay for the location of Temmet's tomb, which only they know.
timeline.quote: Mahitab and Niharet were the only remaining members of the crew that had entombed Temmet, the only ones who knew where he could be found.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Niharet persuades Mahitab to accept the job by saying they could have a home with windows.
timeline.quote: Wouldn't it be nice to have a home with windows?

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Basri kneels and vows to protect the twins with his life.
timeline.quote: You have my word. My life for theirs, if that's what it takes.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Ketramose marches toward Naktamun with Temmet.
timeline.quote: Ketramose turned his back and began to march toward Naktamun.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

relations.note: The monument stands in the city by the river.
relations.quote: The building sat at the edge of the river

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

relations.note: protects the city from the desert wastes
relations.quote: a wall powerful enough to stop the sand and shadows that stalked the wastes.

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.
